Priya Singh: Quick heads-up for QBR prep on Starlight — embeddings token usage shot up last 48h. Need: immediate mitigations, a slide with cost impact, and an enablement note for their eng PM. Jordan, can you pull hourly usage? Alex, short per-route limit + cache snippet? Mei, QBR slide owner? Carlos, a savings estimate if we cut tokens 50% for 30d? Thanks.
cs-alert-bot: ALERT: account=starlight metric=embedding_tokens window=48h change=+318% peak=2024-06-09T03:00:00Z
Jordan Alvarez: Running hourly rollup now. Early look says the spike aligns with a nightly backfill hitting /v1/embeddings with huge batches.
Jordan Alvarez: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hour, sum(tokens) tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='starlight' AND feature='embeddings' AND ts > now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
-- sample peak hour 2024-06-09T03:00:00Z => ~1.1M tokens
```
Alex Kim: Short-term options: 1) per-route rate limits, 2) lower client batch sizes, 3) client caching for repeats, 4) fallback to smaller embedding model. I'll draft a curl admin snippet and a one-paragraph customer note.
Mei Chen: For slide deck: include hourly delta chart, estimated $ delta, what we did, and next steps. Also call out risk to renewal if not addressed. Can someone give a quick $savings calc?
Carlos Duarte: Rough back-of-envelope: current 7d run-rate => ~$5.2k/mo on embeddings. 50% reduction => ~$2.8k/mo. Approx, excludes committed discounts and infra.
Priya Singh: Immediate tasks: Jordan reduce/pause the backfill tonight or drop batch size; Alex provide snippets + 1-paragraph support text; Carlos add numbers to slide; Mei update deck. I'll draft the customer-facing email after reviewing Alex's note. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: Admin API snippet:
`curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/routes/limits" -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"/accounts/starlight/embeddings","rate_per_minute":800,"burst":1600}'`
Alex Kim: Lightweight client cache pseudocode:
```python
from collections import OrderedDict
class LRUCache(dict):
    # simplified
    pass
cache = LRUCache()
def get_embedding(text):
    if text in cache: return cache[text]
    e = call_embeddings(text)
    cache[text] = e
    return e
```
Jordan Alvarez: Reduced nightly batch from 12k -> 3k and paused one backfill. Monitoring.
cs-alert-bot: UPDATE: account=starlight embedding_tokens delta_last_hour=-68% status=mitigated
Priya Singh: Great. Note for QBR: "Mitigation applied; recommend client caching + per-route limits + model fallback; projected 40-60% monthly cost reduction if fully adopted." I'll assemble the slide and customer email. Thanks team. :rocket:
